description: OpenCode's control port drives the agent and is unauthenticated by default: anything that can reach it owns the session. This guard pins the two properties that make the sidecar safe — the server is bound to a loopback address and a per-launch password is generated — and pins the absence of the shortcut that would undo both, binding to 0.0.0.0. A source guard rather than a runtime test because the dangerous version also works.
